additional_info.subject: ID0477818-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / N9 160381798] Modbus is not connected CRM:03289000537
additional_info.body:
Dear Tom,
Thank you for providing us with a timestamp.
We have checked the logs of the charger during the timestamp, and we indeed found the error about the modbus not being connected.
A modbus being disconnected can have three possible causes, but in this case we only found one cause that affected the error to appear.
In the log below, you can see that at that time the network connection was unstable, and this made the modbus loose the connection too.
After a few minutes the connection of the modbus reconnected again, and we don`t see any errors appearing over the last 24 hours.
The charger looks stable and healthy.
Please provide us with feedback if this answered your question.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

ID0477818-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / N9 160381798] Modbus is not connected CRM:03209000224
additional_info.body:
Dear Tom,
Thank you for providing us with the timestamp and screenshots of the charging sessions.
We have checked the logs in the given timestamps and see that these are charging sessions on dc2.
As you can see in the following log, in the pre-charge fase, the charger was able to reach the maximum kw.
This means that the charger is able to provide this maximum kw during a charging session.
In the following log, you are able to see that the charger is only providing the kw that the car is asking for, and not more.
The charger is following the request of the car.
At the end of the charging session the car was not requesting for more power, so the charger also didn`t provide this to the car.
This is the case for all the charging sessions. This means the charger is able to provide the maximum kw, but only provides the kw that the car is requesting.
We hope to have informed you enough regarding this request.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
